description: SwipeLeft universal discovery-source catalog. Universal content only — never customer-specific. Consumed anonymously by every ServiceMatch deployment (back_end/cmdb/discovery_sources_catalog.py). Token normalization: lowercase, spaces/hyphens -> underscores.
note_ad_computers: Active Directory computer objects are DELIBERATELY absent: AD is merge-only corroboration and may never originate CIs (PLAN_CSDM5 item 21).

sources.notes: Microsoft Intune (cloud MDM). Variant tokens from Pro sessions 2#8 and amicus-prof 2026-06-09.
Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager hardware inventory. The software/services inventories are app_feeder side-files, not device discovery.
APM application-tier feeder, not endpoint discovery. Trusted-known so audits treat it as recognized (B115-SIM-1-APPD-SEED, 2026-06-13).
Network-scan inventory; consultant review recommended when primary.
Datadog agent-based infrastructure monitoring — the Hosts API pull (GET /api/v1/hosts), one row per host the Agent reports; hostname-only identity, no serial. B499, 2026-11-19.
Cisco Catalyst Center (formerly DNA Center) Intent API network-device inventory — switches, routers, wireless controllers and their access points; serial from the chassis. B514, 2026-11-19.
Qualys VMDR Host List Detection export — one row per host x QID: findings about devices the discovery sources already know, never device rows; no serial anywhere. B509, 2026-11-19.
Datadog Service Catalog (GET /api/v2/services/definitions, schema v2.2) — one definition per service: owner team, tier, lifecycle, contacts; CSDM evidence, never device rows. B515, 2026-11-19.
